description: This file contains utility functions for building Prisma query clauses, including 'makeOrderBy', 'makeWhereClause', and 'makeSqlCondition', specifically for filtering and sorting data in a data table context.

methods.name: makeOrderBy
methods.description: Creates an order by clause for Prisma queries based on sorting state.

methods.name: makeWhereClause
methods.description: Builds a Prisma where clause for filtering data based on provided filter values and optional JSON path.

methods.name: makeSqlCondition
methods.description: Generates raw SQL conditions for filtering, compatible with Prisma's SQL tag.
